This disconnect distracted me from enjoying what is otherwise a nicely executed bit of gore.

item.content:encoded:
Regarding the blackboxes: I didn't intend it that way, no.

Everyone who was there at all got infected. About a quarter of the people who were there were actually involved in the 643 mess. Everyone passed out a roughly the same time from overeating, but the nomming that was done was focused on a few people. Those who just happened to get yanked in while walking by were relatively unscathed, while some people just got wrecked.

I can't read it all now, but for the first part that I did read, the spoken dialogue felt like a kid trying to be "fancy" and speaking with his pinky out.

EDIT: The fact that it is not MC&D doesn't really excuse the dialogue. Overall, it feels disjointed (heh) and relies solely on squick, and not very effective squick at that. -1
